About these 3 rides

They ride on Wednesdays, Fridays and Sundays. Starts run from 5:30 am to 7:00 am. Beginners are welcome on 1 of them. By bike: 2 road and 1 social. All 3 run every week. Each one was checked at its source between Oct 2 and Oct 26, 2026.
